gloss: to send; to ship; to dispatch

definitions.gloss: to send; to ship; to dispatch
definitions.explanation: To send out goods, packages, or documents from a sender to a recipient, typically through postal or delivery services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発送|はっそう}する。
⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: The ordered item will be shipped tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{速達|そくたつ}→速達：04393_sokutatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{発送|はっそう}した⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{明後日|あさって}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧です。
examples.english: I sent the documents by express mail, so they should arrive the day after tomorrow.

notes:
Refers specifically to the act of sending out goods or mail — the sender's side of the shipping process. It focuses on the point of dispatch rather than the delivery to the recipient.

USAGE:
- Takes the particle ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発送|はっそう}する
- Very common in e-commerce and business contexts
- Often appears in email notifications: 「⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発送|はっそう}しました」 (Your item has been shipped)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発送|はっそう}する: to ship a product
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発送|はっそう}する: to send a package
- ⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧{日|び}: shipping date
- ⟦{発送|はっそう}{済|ず}み→発送済み：15440_hassouzumi⟧: shipped, dispatched
- ⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: shipping procedure
- ⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧: sender, shipper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{配送|はいそう}する→配送する：21738_haisousuru⟧: to deliver — focuses on the delivery process and getting the item to the recipient
- ⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send — the most general word for sending things or people
- ⟦{出荷|しゅっか}→出荷：05135_shukka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ship (from warehouse) — a business/logistics term for shipping goods from a warehouse or factory
